description: Figure 8 is a grouped bar chart that compares the performance of three different audio-language models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni—on two evaluation metrics: MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR. The horizontal axis displays the three models, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70. For each model, two bars are shown: a blue bar for MMAU and a purple bar for MMAR. The chart shows that for all three models, the MMAU accuracy is higher than the MMAR accuracy. Specifically, the Qwen-2.5-Omni model achieves the highest accuracy for both metrics, with its MMAU score reaching approximately 65% and its MMAR score around 57%. The Audio-Reasoner model has the second-highest performance, with MMAU at about 62% and MMAR at around 37%. The Qwen2-Audio-Instruct model shows the lowest performance, with MMAU at approximately 48% and MMAR at about 30%.
